solution:
**Given:**

Class intervals and frequencies: 10-20 → 29, 20-30 → 35, 30-40 → 25, 40-50 → 10, 50-60 → 18, 60-70 → 34, 70-80 → 17

**Formula used:**

{Mode} = L + dfrac{(f₁ - f₀)}{(2f₁ - f₀ - f₂)} times h
